analytics.avgCycle: The average time of a process
analytics.byStepHint: Where the process stands the longest
analytics.needProcessText: The analytics appears after the first runs.
analytics.noStepsText: Start a process and walk it through — the stopwatch of the departments will start counting.

onError.help: What to do if the step failed: stop the process (the default), continue, or go down the «Error» branch.
onError.label: On error

retryMaxTries.help: How many times to repeat a failed external call before applying «On error».
retryMaxTries.label: Retries on failure (0–5)

create.subtitle: The canvas opens next: a trigger, the steps, an end
create.title: New process

editor.archiveText: It will disappear from the list. The running instances block the archiving.
editor.botWebhookHint: After the publication the bot connects automatically (a public API address is needed). On localhost set this address on the bot by hand through setWebhook.
editor.dragHint: (drag it onto the canvas or click)
editor.hrWarnSubtitle: It does not forbid the publication — but the decision taken is written into the log of the organization
editor.hrWarnTitle: The route diverges from the rules of the HR record-keeping
editor.leaveText: The unsaved changes of the canvas will be lost.
editor.paletteHelp: Drag a node onto the canvas. Connect the port dots. Dragging from a port into the empty space offers a quick choice of the next node.
editor.published: Published — the process can be started
editor.settingsHint: The settings of the process: the name, the visibility, the credentials, the archive
editor.startFormHint: The fields the initiator fills in when pressing «Start». They are available to the nodes as form substitutions.
editor.tgReply: To answer: add a «Telegram» node (the same credential token), set Chat ID to the value of
editor.webhookAfterPublish: The URL appears after the process is published.
editor.webhookHint: An external system (Kaspi, 1C, a website…) calls this address with a POST and the process starts. The request body becomes the form values.

empty.canEdit: Create the first one: draw a chain of tasks and approvals on the canvas.
empty.readOnly: Once the managers create processes, they will appear here.
empty.title: There are no processes yet

runAsUserId.help: On whose behalf the process runs when it starts automatically (it creates the tasks and sends the notifications).
runAsUserId.label: On behalf of

inbox.emptyText: The department tasks you can take and the approvals will appear here.
inbox.subtitle: The queued tasks of your department and the approvals on you

instance.cancelText: The open step tasks will be cancelled and the process will close as cancelled.
instance.formHint: The values the process was started with
instance.notFoundText: It may have been deleted, or you have no access.
instance.reassignHint: The reward for the task is re-frozen onto the new assignee
instance.stepsHint: How long each step took and who carried it
instance.title: Process run

issue.agentCycle: «{node}»: a cycle of agent tools (the agents refer to each other in a circle)
issue.duplicateTemplateTrigger: Two triggers on the very same template in one route — leave one
issue.edgeFromMissing: An edge out of a node that does not exist («{id}»)
issue.edgeIntoTrigger: Edges cannot lead into a start trigger (it has no input)
issue.edgeToMissing: An edge into a node that does not exist («{id}»)
issue.externalTemplateGenerate: The template «{name}» is for the documents with counterparties: the «Generate a document» node cannot create one on a route — such documents are sent to the counterparty from the card
issue.externalTemplateTrigger: The template «{name}» is for the documents with counterparties: they are sent to the counterparty from the card, and a route for them will appear together with a sending node
issue.forkNeedsBranches: «{node}»: a fork must have at least two branches
issue.joinNeedsBranches: «{node}»: a join must take at least two branches
issue.noTrigger: There is no start trigger — add, for example, a «Manual start»
issue.notAMember: The chosen person is not an employee of the organization
issue.outputDangling: The node «{node}»: the output «{port}» leads nowhere
issue.outputTaken: The output «{port}» of the node «{node}» already has an edge — several branches are only allowed on a «Fork»
issue.runAsRankTooHigh: «On behalf of» can only name an employee whose role is not above yours — otherwise the process would borrow somebody else’s rights
issue.selectWithoutOptions: The form field «{field}»: the list has no options
issue.selfEdge: An edge of a node onto itself is not allowed
issue.subNodeDetached: «{node}» is not connected to an agent
issue.subNodeTaken: A sub-node is already connected to the input «{port}» of the node «{node}»
issue.templateRouteTaken: This template already has a published route — «{name}». Unpublish it or choose another template
issue.unreachable: The node «{node}» is unreachable from a start trigger

journal.emptyText: Start a process — it will appear here with the timing by step.
journal.emptyTitle: There are no started processes yet
journal.subtitle: Who started it, where the token is now and how long it has been running
journal.title: Run log

richcard.description: Performs an action on an order, a task, an event or a listing (confirm an order, accept or take a task, RSVP…) on behalf of the initiator. The rights are re-checked. The object id comes from the form or from a previous step.
richcard.title: Card action

agent.description: The orchestrating brain: a Model (mandatory), a Memory (optional) and Tools (as many as you like) connect to the ports below. The agent decides by itself which tools to call. It can be connected to another agent as a tool.

toolDescription.label: Description (when the agent is a tool)
toolDescription.placeholder: Why another agent should call this one

agent.title: AI agent

generate.description: A plain request to an AI over the API (Claude or GPT). Its own prompt and model on every node. Substitutions '{{'form.x'}}' and '{{'steps.x'}}' are supported. The result lands in output.text.
generate.title: AI

memory.description: The memory of the agent by a session key: it remembers the context between the runs of the process with the same key (the client id from the form, for example).
memory.title: Memory

model.description: An AI model (Claude or GPT) — it connects to an agent. One model can be connected to several agents.
model.title: Model

parser.description: Connects to an agent and makes it return a strict JSON with the fields you need. The result lands in output.data (the fields are available as '{{'steps.agent.data.field'}}').

fields.label: JSON fields (one «key: description» per line)
fields.placeholder:
decision: approve or reject
reason: a short reason
amount: a number

parser.title: Structured answer

condition.description: Splits the flow in two by a form field: the «Yes» branch and the «No» branch.
condition.title: If

set.description: Computes new fields by expressions over the form values and the results of the previous steps.
set.title: Set data

delay.description: Holds the process for the given time and continues by itself.
delay.title: Pause

file.description: Puts the document on the Drive of the organization: into the registry of its own kind and, if the kind is set up that way, into the personal file of the employee. There is one file — it is simply visible in two places.
file.title: File it away

generate.description: Creates a new document by a template on the basis of the current one (an order out of an application). The data of the organization and of the employee is filled in by itself.
generate.title: Generate a document

register.description: Gives the document a number by the format of its kind and enters it into the registration book. The number is issued here and not at the creation: the drafts do not eat the numbering.
register.title: Registration

end.description: The end of a branch. The process finishes when all its branches have reached an end.
end.title: End

record.description: Records an expense or an income in the Finance book of the ORGANIZATION (management accounting; the book is created by itself). The amount is in tenge and supports the substitutions '{{'form.amount'}}' and '{{'steps.x.y'}}'.
record.title: Finance: record an entry

apply.description: Applies the HR action of the order: on the date it takes effect, but not earlier than the signature. A date in the future makes the action wait for it; the legality check (art. 54 of the Labour Code of Kazakhstan) is repeated at the moment it is applied.
apply.title: Apply the HR action

esutd.description: Queues the submission to ESUTD (erdo.enbek.kz) with a deadline by the working calendar: a conclusion within 5 working days, an amendment within 15 calendar days, a termination within 3 working days (Rules № 353). Usually the application of the action queues it by itself; the node is for the routes where the submission is needed separately.
esutd.title: Submit to ESUTD

approval.description: Sends the item to a person for an approval, a signature or an acknowledgement. The decision is taken in the shared decision stack — from a notification, from the home screen or on the card itself.

assigneeMode.help: The relative recipients (a manager…) are taken from the org structure at the moment of the step; no manager found means the owner of the organization.
assigneeMode.label: Who decides

option.subject: The party of the document (the employee named in the order)
option.subject_manager: The manager of the party of the document

kind.help: An acknowledgement has a single outcome: it cannot be refused.
kind.label: What is required

rule.help: The composition is frozen as a snapshot at the moment the step reaches the people.
rule.label: How many answers are needed

signatureLevel.help: HR documents are signed with a QES under art. 33 of the Labour Code of Kazakhstan. The level is usually taken from the kind of the document.
signatureLevel.label: What to sign with

option.pep: With a simple signature (an SMS code)

approval.title: Decision by a person

task.description: Creates a task in Tasks (with the chat and the reminders) and waits for it to be accepted. In the «Department» mode the task goes into a queue and any member of the department can take it. Substitutions '{{'form.field'}}' are supported.

assigneeMode.help: The manager is taken from the org structure at the moment of the step; if no manager is found, the owner of the organization is used.
assigneeMode.label: Assignee

description.placeholder: What has to be done (the assignee sees it)

task.title: Task for a person

kaspi.description: The orders of the Kaspi Shop: fetch the new ones, accept, complete (the token comes from the seller cabinet). Kaspi has no webhooks — poll it on a schedule.
kaspi.title: Kaspi Shop

odata.description: A request to a published 1C database over the standard OData (the basic auth lives in a credential). The database must be reachable publicly.
odata.title: 1C (OData)

sms.description: Sends an SMS through Mobizon.kz (the apiKey lives in a credential). The alphanumeric sender name is registered in advance.
sms.title: SMS (Mobizon)

telegram.description: Sends a message through a Telegram bot (the @BotFather token lives in a credential). In the flow it sends the given text; connect the «as a tool» output to an AI agent and the agent decides when to write and what to write. Substitutions '{{'form.x'}}' and '{{'steps.x'}}' are supported.

text.help: Mandatory for a plain node. If the node is connected to an agent as a tool, the agent writes the text.

telegram.title: Telegram

whatsapp.description: Sends a message through the WhatsApp Cloud API (the access token lives in a credential; templates are needed outside the 24-hour window). Substitutions are supported.
whatsapp.title: WhatsApp

each.description: Goes through the items of a list one by one: the «Each» output runs for every item, and the «Done» output runs once at the end.

source.help: A link to an array: the result of a previous step or a form field.
source.label: List (where from)

each.title: Loop over a list

notify.description: Sends a notification to the initiator or to a chosen employee. Substitutions are supported; it can be connected to an AI agent as a tool.

title.help: Mandatory for a plain node. As a tool of an agent the text is written by the agent (it goes to the initiator).

option.initiator: To the initiator of the process

notify.title: Notify

join.description: Waits for all the incoming branches and continues as one flow.
join.title: Join

split.description: Splits the flow into several branches that run in parallel.
split.title: Fork

start.description: Starts another published process of this organization as a sub-process (on behalf of the initiator). There is a depth guard against recursion. The form values are passed as JSON.

definitionId.label: Process (definition id)
definitionId.placeholder: the id of a published process

start.title: Start a process

http.description: Calls an external API (Kaspi, 1C, any REST). It supports the substitutions '{{'form.field'}}' in the URL and the body, the headers and the credentials from the safe. The answer is available to the next steps.

url.help: Mandatory for a plain node. As a tool of an agent the URL is filled in by the agent (a GET, a read).
url.label: URL

http.title: HTTP request

message.description: Sends a message to a chat or a direct message to an employee on behalf of the initiator (who must have access to the chat). Substitutions '{{'form.x'}}' and '{{'steps.x'}}' are supported; it can be connected to an AI agent as a tool.

text.help: Mandatory for a plain node. As a tool of an agent the text is written by the agent.

option.chat: To a chat by its id
option.member: A direct message to an employee

message.title: Chat message

assign.description: Assigns a position (and a branch) to an employee on behalf of the initiator — the initiator must be a Manager or above. For example, to grant a position automatically on hiring.
assign.title: Assign a position

start.description: A start by the «Start» button: the initiator fills the form and starts the process. It is the entry point — you can delete it if the process only starts automatically.
start.title: Manual start

document.description: Starts the route when an employee submits a document by the chosen template. The fields of the submission form are available as '{{'form.field'}}'.

templateId.help: One template — one route. The publication will not let a second published route onto the same template.
templateId.label: Document template

document.title: A document was submitted

event.description: Starts the process on a platform event: an employee was hired, a position was assigned, a task was completed or created, and so on.

condField.help: Start only if this field of the event satisfies the condition.
condField.label: Condition: the event field (optional)

event.title: SuperApp event

schedule.description: Starts the process automatically every N hours or days. The form is not filled in (the default values are used).
schedule.title: On a schedule

telegram.description: Starts the process when someone writes to the bot in Telegram. Available to the nodes: the text as '{{'form.text'}}', the chat as '{{'form.chatId'}}', the name as '{{'form.fromName'}}'. The answer goes through the Telegram node.

credentialId.help: A bearer credential with the token from @BotFather. After the publication the webhook of the bot sets itself up (a public API address is needed; on localhost set it by hand).
credentialId.label: Bot token (credential)

telegram.title: Telegram: incoming

webhook.description: An external system (Kaspi, 1C, a website…) calls a public URL and the process starts. The URL appears in this panel after the publication; the request body becomes the form values.
webhook.title: Webhook

role.description: Changes the role of an employee in the organization on behalf of the initiator — the initiator must be an Admin or above (the owner and the contractor cannot be assigned).
role.title: Change the role of an employee

transaction.created: An entry was recorded in Finance

hr.acknowledgeRequired: The employee must be acquainted with the order: add a «A decision by a person» step of the «Acknowledge» kind
hr.ecpRequired: An HR document is signed with a QES (art. 33 of the Labour Code of Kazakhstan): in the «Sign» step choose «What to sign with → QES», otherwise the signature is a button click
hr.orderRequired: Under the HR record-keeping of Kazakhstan the ground is an order: add «Generate a document», otherwise only the application stays in the file
hr.personalFileRequired: A signed document is worth filing into the personal file: add a «File it away» step
hr.registerRequired: The order needs a number: add a «Registration» step, otherwise the document will not enter the registration book
hr.signatureRequired: The order must be signed by the head: add a «A decision by a person» step of the «Sign» kind

settings.name: Name
settings.title: Process settings
settings.versionsHint: The running processes live out their own version — the edits do not disturb them.
settings.visibilityHint: «Admins only» is for the processes of the developers and the management

start.noForm: No form is needed — the process starts right away
start.title: Start «{name}»
start.withForm: The form values go into the first step

subtitle: A builder of business processes: tasks for departments, approvals, automation
title: Processes

validation.assigneeRequired: Choose an employee as the assignee
validation.botTokenRequired: Choose a credential with the bot token
validation.formFieldUnknown: There is no such form field
validation.runAsRequired: Choose on whose behalf the process runs
validation.subjectMissing: The step is addressed to the party of the document, but the run has none: this route is started by submitting a document with an employee as a party
